randomizer: Uniform on the sixteen listed initialization seeds, enumerated completely. Exact probabilities and expected capped operation/check counts refer to this finite randomizer only. Recorded wall clocks are realized descriptive clocks, not population expected runtimes. Deterministic methods have identical mathematical outputs across seeds.
primary_estimand: Success probability for an all-adapted-policy loss at most 1e-4, plus expected capped evaluation/update/solve/check counts under the declared finite randomizer. Failures retain their complete budget and are not conditioned away.
cost_scope: Initialization, every attempted fit and policy improvement, failed and successful outward checks, compressed candidate writes and fsynced attempt writes; package imports and final summary are separate whole-job overhead.
target: Discrete-time stochastic capital-adjustment economy on R^d with continuous correlated Gaussian shocks, full R^d controls, 24 reoptimized dates, and uniform initial RMS stock deviation at most one.
training_information: Exact own-policy population derivative-regression targets. The trainable square-activation neural factor and a conventional quadratic representation receive the same evaluation information. This is a policy-certificate and factorization comparison, not an assertion of simulation efficiency or neural necessity.
verification: Independent coercive Bellman-residual certificate; no optimal gain or Riccati value enters the verifier. A separate strong Riccati comparator is fully retained.
primary_interpretation: A completed full-policy stress test can repair the finite-catalogue composition gap. It cannot by itself establish NBO cost dominance, empirical calibration, or a continuous-time transfer theorem.
pilot: Any development checks use only excluded small dimensions/horizons and seed 17. No primary service executes before remote source-hash commitment.
amendments: Any post-freeze code change must be separately logged, with old source bytes and all primary attempt records preserved.
